subject: Siemens ISV co-engineering playbook & marketplace gating items
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Siemens ISV co-engineering playbook & marketplace gating items

Team —

Quick heads-up: Siemens (ISV org) is asking for a joint co-engineering playbook that outlines technical integration steps, marketplace gating requirements, and an expected timeline for listing in their cloud store. I’m prepping a short playbook draft to share with them on Wednesday, but I need product and integration input to make it actionable.

High-level asks we should cover in the playbook:
- Required integration points for marketplace listing (billing, SSO, provisioning)
- Deployment contract options (hosted API vs private/VPC) they can list as "product variants"
- Security/compliance docs they typically require and the gap-list (SOC2, data residency attestations)
- Minimal engineering changes for our SDKs/ops to meet their gating checklist
- Proposed rollout plan and verification steps (staging listing, test purchases)

Please reply with the following by EOD Tuesday:
1) Owner(s) for each of the bullets above (product, integrations, infra, legal)
2) Any non-negotiable constraints (e.g., cannot expose raw logs, min contract term)
3) Rough ETA for a technical artifact we can share (diagram + config examples)

I’ll stitch the inputs into a one-pager and attach it to the outreach. Thanks —

Karthik
Principal Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Siemens ISV co-engineering playbook & marketplace gating items

Thanks — sending initial product/integration asks below. I’m happy to own the PO side but will need Jonas to validate the operational steps.

Product/integration asks (first pass):
- SSO / SAML + SCIM support for enterprise customers via marketplace-managed provisioning. Owner: laura_bennett.
- Offer both hosted API (Redwood hosted) and Private (VPC) listing options. Private listing requires an onboarding checklist and a staging verification. Owner: jonas_weber.
- Billing: support for marketplace-mediated billing (SaaS metering) and direct invoicing for strategic customers. Need Marissa to confirm billing flows.
- Model version pinning and a clear rollback policy (pins in manifest and canary routes). Owner: laura_bennett + infra.
- Telemetry & audit hooks: only aggregated, PII-filtered telemetry exposed to partners; raw request logs require explicit customer consent. Owner: neha_kapoor (compliance).
- Packaging: short config examples for Helm/K8s for Private deployment + API integration sample. ETA for diagrams/configs: 7 business days. Owner for artifacts: jonas_weber and hiro_tanaka.

Constraints / blockers to call out:
- We cannot offer data residency guarantees for models that use third-party hosting unless we provision a private enclave (adds lead time).
- SOC2 Type II evidence is available but will need a redacted bundle for marketplace review.

If folks confirm owners I’ll add a short section with verification steps and success criteria.

- Laura
Senior PM, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Morrison <leah.morrison@siemens.com>, marketplace@siemenscloudpartner.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Siemens ISV co-engineering playbook & marketplace gating items

Hi Leah / Siemens Marketplace team —

Great to connect. Per our conversation last week, we put together an initial co-engineering playbook outline and a short list of gating items we expect the marketplace to validate. Attaching a simple outline for your review (redwood_coeng_outline_v1.docx).

Key asks for Siemens to confirm:
- Preferred billing integration: marketplace metered billing or vendor-managed direct invoicing for enterprise customers?
- Data residency requirements for listed products (EU-only, multi-region, or no specific restriction?).
- Any mandatory security artifacts (SSO, SOC2 attachments, penetration test reports) and the format you prefer for submission.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync to review the checklist and map owners on both sides. I’m available Wed/Thu morning CET. If you prefer, share your checklist and we’ll call out gaps and deliverables.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_coeng_outline_v1.docx (docx, 42KB)
From: Leah Morrison <leah.morrison@siemens.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Vogel <markus.vogel@siemens.com>, marketplace@siemenscloudpartner.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 14:20:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Siemens ISV co-engineering playbook & marketplace gating items

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the outline — that helps. Attached is our standard ISV gating checklist (Siemens_ISV_Gating_Checklist.xlsx). Quick clarifying questions:

1) Data residency: many of our customers will require EU-only hosting. Can Redwood guarantee that for a Private listing? If not, what is the minimum lead time to provision an EU-resident Private instance?
2) Billing: we support both marketplace-mediated billing and direct vendor invoicing. For marketplace billing we need metering hooks (consumption events) and a reconciliation report. Is that something Redwood can emit from the hosted product?
3) Security artifacts: we need SOC2 Type II summary, recent pen-test summary (high-level), and confirmation of KMS/HSM usage for keys. We accept redacted bundles uploaded to our SFTP or a secure SharePoint link.

We’re available for a short sync on Thursday 13:00-14:00 CET or Friday 09:00-10:00 CET. Let us know which works and any additional owners we should include.

Best,
Leah Morrison
Partner Programs, Siemens Cloud Marketplace
Attachment: Siemens_ISV_Gating_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Siemens ISV co-engineering playbook & marketplace gating items

Karthik — forwarding Leah’s notes and drafting proposed answers for the sync. Quoting Leah below for context:

> 1) Data residency: many of our customers will require EU-only hosting. Can Redwood guarantee that for a Private listing? If not, what is the minimum lead time to provision an EU-resident Private instance?
> 2) Billing: we support both marketplace-mediated billing and direct vendor invoicing. For marketplace billing we need metering hooks (consumption events) and a reconciliation report. Is that something Redwood can emit from the hosted product?
> 3) Security artifacts: we need SOC2 Type II summary, recent pen-test summary (high-level), and confirmation of KMS/HSM usage for keys. We accept redacted bundles uploaded to our SFTP or a secure SharePoint link.

Suggested answers / owners:
- Data residency (answer): We can support EU-only hosting for Private deployment via our EU region dedicated package. Lead time: typically 6-8 weeks to provision and validate (owner: hiro_tanaka).
- Billing (answer): Hosted product can emit consumption events and a daily reconciliation report via our billing export API (owner: marissa_cole). For marketplace-mediated billing we'll add a reconciliation CSV and webhook for event delivery (ETA 3 weeks to add small adapter).
- Security artifacts (answer): SOC2 Type II summary and a high-level pen-test report exist; we can prepare a redacted bundle and share over secure SFTP (owner: neha_kapoor). KMS/HSM: keys are managed via customer KMS integrations or our HSM-backed keystore for enterprise private deployments.

Action owners I propose to put on the sync:
- Product verification & success criteria: laura_bennett
- Billing & marketplace adapter: marissa_cole
- Private provisioning & infra owner: hiro_tanaka
- Compliance bundle & uploads: neha_kapoor
- Partner ops / contract questions: tessa_morgan

If everyone agrees, I’ll share these answers with Leah and lock the 30-minute slot for Thursday 13:00 CET.

- Jonas
Technical Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Leah / Markus —

Thanks for the checklist and the proposed sync window — we’ve confirmed owners and drafted responses to your questions (see summary below). We’ve booked the 30-minute sync for Thursday 13:00 CET and attached the playbook draft and checklist for review.

Summary / action items:
- EU-only Private provision: owner hiro_tanaka, ETA 6-8 weeks to provision a dedicated EU instance.
- Billing adapter: owner marissa_cole, will deliver a reconciliation CSV + webhook adapter (ETA ~3 weeks).
- Compliance bundle: owner neha_kapoor, will upload a redacted SOC2 + pen-test summary to your secure drop by next Tuesday.
- Product verification: owner laura_bennett to prepare staging verification steps and test purchase flow (ETA 7 business days).

Attachments: redwood_coeng_outline_v1.docx, Siemens_ISV_Gating_Checklist.xlsx
Meeting: https://meet.redwood.ai/s/siemens-coeng-30 (Thursday 13:00 CET)

Next steps (internal): please update the shared playbook doc with the artifacts and ETA fields before Tuesday COB so I can hand over the bundle to Siemens during the sync.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Partnerships, Redwood Inference
